system.description:
Gravity Clamp: Make an Interface Roll
to temporarily lift a target you can see
up into the air and move them within
Close range of their original position.
Memory Scrub: Spend a Hope to force
a target within Melee range to make a
Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, you
overwrite, scramble, or suppress the
last minute of their short-term
memory, causing them to forget the
last minute of your conversation.
Repulsion Circle: Mark a Stress to
deploy a temporary repulsion field,
shock ring, or kinetic perimeter on the
ground where you stand. All
adversaries within Melee range, or who
enter Melee range, take 2d12+4 techno
damage and are knocked back to Very
Close range.
